comparison.objective: Match and replace lids on their corresponding tins, versus commission an axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Fit selection, alignment, and lid seating; no hex-key operation, retained collar adjustment, or iterative impact diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Each tin correctly re-lidded rather than two safe carriage cycles and a witness-torque retention test.
comparison.reason: Alignment and seating are generic primitives; the tested mechanisms and outcomes differ.
